title: A tale of two allocations: Risk capital contributions versus risk contributions in the tail
abstract: arXiv:2609.36177v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We compare two natural proportional notions of a risk component's contribution to the aggregate tail risk of a collection of risks: the fraction of aggregate tail risk capital allocated to the component under Conditional Tail Expectation (CTE), and the component's expected realized share of aggregate risk under Geometric Tail Expectation (GTE). The resulting proportional allocations generally differ. For arbitrary random vectors-allowing atoms, signed risks, and any tail domain--we establish when the allocations agree, determine their ordering when they do not, and characterize their asymptotic separation.   Both proportional allocations are weighted averages of the conditional risk share of a component given the aggregate: the proportional CTE allocation weights tail scenarios by severity, whereas the proportional GTE allocation weights them uniformly. translated_title: 两种分摊的故事：尾部风险中的风险资本贡献与风险贡献之比较
translated_abstract: 我们比较了风险分量对一组风险的总尾部风险贡献的两种自然的比例概念：在条件尾部期望（CTE）下分配给该分量的总尾部风险资本的比例，以及在几何尾部期望（GTE）下该分量对总风险的期望实现份额。由此得到的比例分摊通常并不相同。对于任意随机向量（允许原子分布、带符号的风险以及任意尾部区域），我们建立了两种分摊何时一致的结论，确定了它们不一致时的大小排序，并刻画了它们的渐近分离程度。两种比例分摊都是给定总量时分量的条件风险份额的加权平均：比例CTE分摊按尾部情景的严重程度加权，而比例GTE分摊则对尾部情景均匀加权。因此，两者的差异是一个归一化的尾部协方差。（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文比较了CTE下的比例风险资本分摊与GTE下的比例期望风险份额这两种尾部风险贡献度量，确定了一致条件、排序关系与渐近分离，并证明两者之差是归一化的尾部协方差。
en_tdlr: The paper compares proportional risk capital contributions under CTE with proportional expected realized risk shares under GTE, establishing when they coincide, their ordering, their asymptotic separation, and showing their difference is a normalized tail covariance.
